Alger, 12 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 12, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Studio CD Projekt Red announces the use of artificial intelligence to restore the original Polish voice of the character Geralt in Songs of the Past, a new paid expansion for The Witcher 3 scheduled for 2027.
L'intelligence artificielle au service d: Artificial intelligence at the service of Geralt's original voice
Le studio polonais CD Projekt Red a reco: The Polish studio CD Projekt Red is using artificial intelligence to recover the original Polish voice of Geralt in Songs of the Past, the new paid expansion for The Witcher 3 scheduled for 2027 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Actor Jacek Rozenek, who has voiced Geralt since the beginning of the saga, suffered a stroke in 2019 that altered his voice and affected his ability to speak. To avoid a jarring voice change for players between the old areas and the new lines, the studio chose to have the lines recorded by Jacek Rozenek himself, while applying an artificial intelligence touch-up with his consent.
Pour mener à bien ce projet, CD Projekt: To carry out this project, CD Projekt Red partnered with the Ukrainian company Respeecher. The software relies on about 10,000 lines recorded in 2014 by Jacek Rozenek for the original game to train a model capable of bringing the new vocal takes closer to the original timbre, without altering the actor's performance, intonations, or rhythm. The work required several dozen hours, including model training, adjustments with the studio, and correction of artificial intelligence imperfections. The localization producer at CD Projekt, Mikołaj Szwed, emphasized that this is an ethical use case of this technology.
CD Projekt Red prépare une troisième ext: CD Projekt Red is preparing a third paid expansion for The Witcher 3 named Songs of the Past, scheduled for 2027.
Le comédien Jacek Rozenek enregistre lui: Actor Jacek Rozenek records his new lines himself despite the changes to his voice following his 2019 stroke.
L'entreprise ukrainienne Respeecher est: The Ukrainian company Respeecher is used to apply a model based on 10,000 lines from 2014 to restore the character's original timbre.
Le comédien a donné son accord pour cett: The actor gave his consent for this artificial intelligence touch-up, designed to preserve vocal continuity in the game.
